tagline: Dark navy field with a hairline grid, a segmented progress rail on the left edge lit in lime for the current level, square hairline boxes and a conclusion strip on every page.

palette.description: dark field, cool blue structure, lime for key numbers, orange only for danger

typography.style: neutral sans for structure and Arial Black for numbers and level marks

best_for: Rules-heavy material that audiences must apply on site: manuals, training, standards. Titles are judgeable sentences and every page ends with one conclusion.
avoid_for: Inspirational or brand storytelling; the grid and rail read as procedural.
name: Duty Grid
